steps.name: Ler a folha raw
steps.task: Read the raw sheet, read-only, and compute P&L, exposure, cashflow and TWR. Decide open or closed positions from real buys and sells.

steps.name: Ordenar ao worker
steps.task: When a table or dashboard is needed, write the exact instructions for trader-worker (QUERY/ARRAYFORMULA formulas, ranges).

steps.name: Validar o Sheets
steps.task: Read the sheet after the worker. List every range checked and confirm there is no #N/A, empty column or wrong format.

steps.name: Relatório
steps.task: Send trader only the processed data and the confirmation that the sheet is valid.
